Name: Love Letters Retexture
Author: boringvlln
Description:
Simple replacer for the letters in lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9337]Bouquets to Love Letters[/url] mod.

Overwrite the original image with this new one in order to install. You still need content and manifest files from the original mod.

Unfortunately the original mod is not so compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] (added recipe) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6822]Unsettling Item Descriptions[/url]. You can still use them together while ignoring the mismatch. If someone can figure out a patch, that would be even better.

This is just an image replacer for the letters.

Screenshots are taken with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color - ReShade[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4922]SpriteMaster[/url].
